guard: stock cotal supervise renews the complete remote authority family before the initial five-minute executor expires, remains live through that exact expiry plus five seconds, and cleanly removes its registration
why: The owner-native acceptance preserves the reviewed 4788 PID/start/cgroup signal and cleanup guards, carries the explicit arm through ambient COTAL stripping, and observes the real registry-pinned HTTPS authority exchange.

The expired arm records the initial executor expiry independently, requires a successful proof-preserving five-member renew before it, waits through the original expiry plus five seconds, then grades clean signal shutdown and exact registration removal. The early arm remains a no-renew control.
